newsitem.title: UK: British Gas up after positive comment.
newsitem.headline: British Gas up after positive comment.

text.p: Shares in British Gas Plc rose in heavy trading on Monday after positive weekend press comment, dealers said.
The stock was up 3p at 226-1/2 in volume of 3.3 million shares by 0900 GMT, making it the most active stock in the UK market at that stage.

A report in the Sunday Times said the Monopolies and Mergers Commission, currently examining price cuts demanded by industry regulator Ofgas, may favour a more lenient regime than Ofgas wanted to impose on BG's Transco pipeline operation.
A spokesman for British Gas said the company had no comment on the report, which he described as "purely speculative".
The MMC is due to produce its report on British Gas during April.
British Gas shareholders are due to vote on British Gas's demerger plan on February 12 and if approved the two demerged stocks will begin trading the following Monday.
